name: Korsan Koyu
scene: An ornate domed pirate treasure chest rests in a sheltered cove amid sweeping waves and coastal cliffs.
notes: Second generation selected after one corrective regeneration. Visually checked for open lines, X crossings, shading and colour pairs. Warm colours are confined to the chest; cool colours fill the cove. No obvious loose line ends. Remaining doubts: slight shading persists rather than perfectly flat fills; some adjacent gold chest panes and turquoise sky panes repeat colours; several chest and sky junctions remain crowded or potentially four-way, and some strap/wave regions are narrow. Raster connected-component estimate is 138 coloured regions >=100 pixels, just above target 97–137; this is not a validated geometry pane count. During tracing, merge redundant same-colour divisions and move background dividers to resolve contacts without denting subject contours. Design sheet only, not audited playable geometry or finished glass artwork.
